title: Why LLMs Need a REPL for Their Own Thoughts | A Cinematic Research Brief
base_title: Why LLMs Need a REPL for Their Own Thoughts
description:
Long prompts stop looking like input once you treat them as an environment the model can inspect, filter, and program against.

This cinematic brief compresses the core recursive-language-model move into one structural claim: the model gets stronger when its own thinking scaffold becomes programmable.

It should catch viewers interested in context limits, recursion, and self-orchestrating reasoning systems even if they never saw the original essay.
